body.statement: In the published VMW model, Assumption 1 includes \(Z\perp(X,Y)\mid(T,U)\), \(X\perp(Y,T)\mid U\), causal consistency \(Y=Y(T)\), and latent ignorability \(Y(t)\perp T\mid U\).  Assumption 2 requires \(A_0,A_1,B\) to have full column rank \(k\), and Section 4.2 uses strict latent positivity \(P(T=t\mid U=u)>0\).  These are qualitative conditions: the source does not impose the fixed margins \(\pi_0\) and \(\sigma_0\) used to define \(\mathcal M\).

source.verbatim_statement: The observed variables satisfy \(Z\perp\!\!\!\perp(X,Y)\mid(T,U)\), \(X\perp\!\!\!\perp(Y,T)\mid U\). In addition, we assume causal consistency, \(Y=Y(T)\), and latent ignorability. The matrices \(A_0,A_1,B\) have full column rank \(k\). Strict overlap is \(0<P(T=1\mid U=u)<1\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Assumption 1, Assumption 2, and Section 4.2 of the arXiv HTML/PDF for version 1.
